cold_start: Cold full controller/model-root/finite graph construction included in first call at every geometry. Model load and source/controller setup charged separately with GPU memory and host lifetime highwater records.
timing: Original author synchronized measure(runner) and result destruction. Fresh original model B2 root, every static input refreshed, entire unchanged finite GPU graph replay, strict predicates and all CPU output conversion included.
memory: Capacity for each independently initialized fixed geometry, including model-load/setup peaks and every complete cold and warm attribution call. Report allocated and physical reserved peaks together. The historical v1 descending-geometry transition failure remains archived; no claim of uniformly lower transition-entry memory.
exclusions: No runs excluded. No filtering of slow repetitions or post-hoc early stopping for a winning subset.

acceptance_frozen_before_measurement.required: All four lengths must beat both fixed FT entries in both round means and in pooled means. Pooled mean ratio DT/FT must have a 95% percentile bootstrap upper bound <1.
acceptance_frozen_before_measurement.pooling: Six measured repeats per method per length, all included. Report both rounds individually. If any cell fails, continue efficiency work and retain this entire confirmation.

correctness: Require exact complete vectors and math diagnostics against the unchanged retained path in the same process, using an extra separately charged audit after timing. Keep distance to historical other-cache vectors; no tolerance relaxation within paired correctness checks.
graph_build: One persistent stream, two complete model-root plus finite warmups, one complete program capture and one GPU replay inside first call. Warm buffers and unused previous graph pool freed with all costs charged; no internal peak reset.
graph_validation: Original829 finite predicates and720 replay version observations retained, plus36 original-input equality predicates when SAC active. Full original root score, native decoder boundary and public auxiliary FA checks. Full CPU vector and statistics before return. Source/state contract on every call.
purpose: Final v4 source-pinned production entry versus both untouched FT entries:24 fresh geometry/method/round processes on one C550,120 complete timed API calls including48 cold/warm and72 measured, plus24 output audits and8 original retained references.
accounting: Complete original synchronized author timer with result destruction. Report resident allocated/reserved before and after, peak allocated/reserved, current host RSS and process RSS highwater; model load, setup, runner init, audits, cold calls and close separate. CUDA host section timing is not GPU kernel timing.

acceptance.speed: Each bin and each FT: both independent round means and pooled mean DT<FT;95% percentile bootstrap upper bound for ratio of independent pooled means<1,20000 resamples,seed20260910,n6 per cell. No exclusions.
acceptance.memory: Each bin and each FT: maximum DT allocated and reserved across both fresh processes, model load/setup, all cold/warm/measured API calls, is strictly below FT maximum using exactly the same scope. Report both rounds individually and stable warm peaks.
acceptance.correctness: Every full DT vector and all original score,sum,residual,layer checks exactly equal unmodified retained in the same process; all original native boundary checks and source/state contracts pass.

candidate_scope: Qwen3-8B FP16 B1/E2 fixed eval FA2 model. Original full native model/head/seed/GEMM and FP32 norm boundary unchanged. Same-root SAC with 16 cached q projections at long geometries; original 829 strict predicates plus 36 SAC predicates. Finite FA phase0 32x32/2 warps and phases1/2 64x32/4 warps. Original vendor flash::gemm with owner operands in native MMA registers, unchanged K and reduction order; dead shared A staging reused for B. Complete current vectors and diagnostics, fresh mutable return metadata. All cold compile, graph, copies, validation and return costs charged.

warm_timing_scope: Fresh model/controller/graph process per method, length and round. Each process records two warm calls then three measured complete author API calls. Initially empty disk caches per method, reused only within that method. No same-process geometry transition.
method_order: Within each length, methods in listed order if(index+one_based_round)%2 else reversed. Length order128,256,512,1024 then1024,512,256,128. Every method/length/round has its own model process.
common_loading_scope: Every DT and both FT cell loads the original model on CPU, then calls unmodified model.to(cuda:0). All model-load GPU and host memory and time retained. All 400 parameter/buffer entries verified bit exact to original direct GPU load; no forward changes.
